domain.text: vmethod GitHub workflow tooling: merge-task follow-up clean-check behavior

impressions.text: The task addressed merge-task follow-ups being blocked by untracked files in the main checkout, while preserving refusal for modified tracked files.
The worker changed the cleanliness check to consider tracked files only and reported tests covering successful follow-up with untracked files and refusal with tracked modifications.
The worker reported that initial checks were red because the changelog fragment was missing its required kind; both issues were corrected before checks passed green.
The orchestrator confirmed CI was green and the change merged cleanly.
